subject: Onboarding: FastCart benchmarking POC — thresholds & run cadence
summary: Handoff from Sales to Onboarding/CS for FastCart POC. Defines latency & throughput targets, load windows, artifacts to exchange, and acceptance checklist; includes a short run and requests for payloads and API keys.
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@fastcart.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FastCart POC — proposed benchmarking plan and handoff

Tom / Asha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, we want to run a short POC to validate cost and latency profiles before moving to Dedicated capacity. I've attached a first-pass benchmarking playbook (load_plan_v1.xlsx) and a small set of representative payloads. High-level ask: confirm the traffic profile below and we'll schedule two short runs (baseline and contention).

Quick summary of proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- p95 latency <= 250 ms at sustained 200 RPS (text-generation workload)
- tail (p99) < 600 ms at sustained 200 RPS
- Successful handling of 2-minute burst to 500 RPS without errors (error rate < 0.5%)
- Throughput validation for embedding batch jobs: 1000 embeddings/minute without timeouts

Proposed run cadence:
1) Baseline run (no other tenant traffic simulated) — 30 minutes
2) Contention run (simulated co-tenants + cold cache) — 20 minutes

Logan — looping you in to own the run execution and result sign-off. Monica will help with artefact collection and telemetry.

Attachments: load_plan_v1.xlsx, fastcart_onboard_payloads.zip

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

---
From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@fastcart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart POC — proposed benchmarking plan and handoff

Ben — thanks, this looks good. A few clarifications from our side so the runs exercise realistic behavior:

- Primary workload is the checkout recommendation API (chat-style prompt -> single-generation). Typical payload size is ~2.2 KB, 95th percentile request size ~4.5 KB. I attached an internal note with traffic shape (we will also drop the payloads into the zip you sent).
- Targeting p95 <= 200 ms would be ideal, but we can accept <= 250 ms as the acceptance threshold you listed.
- Peak expected sustained load during promotions: 300 RPS for up to 5 minutes. We can schedule the 500 RPS burst as a knife-edge test, but prioritize 300 RPS as realistic.
- For embeddings: we have nightly bulk jobs that need 1,500 embeddings/minute at peak windows (not continuous). If possible, run a short embedding throughput check as part of the contention run.

Schedule constraints: we prefer testing windows outside 07:00-10:00 PT and 18:00-21:00 PT (user-facing spikes). Available windows this week: Thu 8/27 09:00-12:00 PT or Fri 8/28 13:00-16:00 PT.

One more ask: we need an inventory of the telemetry fields you capture (latency breakdown, token counts, GPU utilization sampling interval) so our SREs can map them into our dashboards.

Thanks —
Tom
Tom Lee
Head of Platform Engineering, FastCart
tom.lee@fastcart.com

---
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@fastcart.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart POC — proposed benchmarking plan and handoff

Tom — great notes, thanks. Updated plan below reflecting realistic loads and your windows. Proposed immediate next steps:

1) Confirm run window: Thu 2026-08-27, 09:30-11:00 PT (baseline at 09:30, contention 10:15) — please confirm.
2) Exchange artefacts: you to push sample payloads and an anonymized traffic trace into the Drive folder by EOD Wed 8/26. We already have a small sample in the zip but we want your production-like mix.
3) Keys & endpoints: we will need a service account API key scoped to a test subdomain (do not use prod keys). Provide to onboarding@redwood.com with the subject line: FastCart-POC-API-KEY.
4) Telemetry matrix: attached below (short list). We'll publish a full telemetry schema to the Drive link.

Acceptance checklist (finalized):
- p95 <= 250 ms (generation) at sustained 200 RPS (primary pass)
- p95 <= 300 ms at sustained 300 RPS (secondary realistic pass)
- p99 < 700 ms during simulated cache cold + contention
- 0.5% or lower error rate across runs
- Embedding throughput: demonstration of 1,500 embeddings/minute in short burst (10 minutes)

Artifacts we'll deliver after each run: detailed latency histogram, token-count distribution, per-route error logs, GPU utilization sample (10s), and a CSV of per-request results (run_results_YYYYMMDD.csv).

I attached a trimmed run script and the telemetry matrix to this thread. Monica — can you own the run orchestration and upload the post-run artifacts to the Drive folder?

Tom — if you confirm the Thu 9:30 start, we'll schedule infra and reserve a reproducibility window.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Tom / Asha — confirmed on our side for Thu 8/27 09:30-11:00 PT. Thank you for the quick turnaround on the payloads — Monica pulled them into the Drive folder and Logan's team validated the basic shapes.

- Please ensure the service account key is uploaded to onboarding@redwood.com by 08:00 PT Thu. We will not run without it.

- We'll post the baseline run_results_20260826.csv to Drive within 90 minutes of completion and leave a short summary report in the HubSpot deal.

If anything changes on your side, flag me directly. Looking forward to the run and a smooth sign-off.
